page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Intellexit igitur, librum esse à Concilio Niceno agnitum pro libro vero & vtili, & qui à fidelibus non debeat inter profanos haberi.
Regula. Multa in summa sunt, quæ fuerunt admissa ab Ecclesia, tanquam veræ historiæ, sed non tanquam dictatæ à Spiritu sancto.
main_text.head: BARVCH.
main_text.p: Ambrosius de fide ad Grat. lib 1. pag. 49 ad-scribit Ieremiæ, & ex hoc citat illud cap. 3 [?]. Posthac in terris visus est, &c. & esse à Spiritu sancto docet. Item Epiphan. lib. 1. hæres. 8. inter Canonicos habet.
Resp. Primùm, fallitur Ambrosius, cùm attribuit Ieremiæ. Secundò, Illius & huius iudicium, non præualet iudicio Ecclesiæ If-raeliticæ, & Hieronymi, tot tantorumq; alio-rum Patrum.
main_text.head: EPISTOLA IEREMIÆ.
main_text.p: Inter Canonicos ponit Origenes in Psalmum primum, & citatur etiam ab Eusebio Cæsar. lib. 6. c. 25.
Epiphanius idem facit in Panar. lib 1. hæ-res.8.
Hilarius in Psalmos idem facit, pag. 429.
main_text.head: SAPIENTIA SALOMONIS.

page.notes: The printed page number reads "47" with a small mark after it; read as 470 [?]. "cap. 3" in the Ambrosius citation is a doubtful numeral. "If-raeliticæ" is printed with a hyphen and the first letters are doubtful; it may be "Israeliticæ" with a misprint. The catchword "Sancto." is below the last line at the right and is not repeated in the text. The "Regula." paragraph and the Barvch heading are set apart as printed.
